title: Qantas Dumps the A380 Early, Virgin Cuts North America, and DOT Lets Airlines Off the Hook for Your Hotel
summary: Qantas just moved up the retirement of its superjumbo fleet by four years — turns out betting on four engines was a mistake everyone's making now. Plus, Virgin Atlantic quietly axes five long-haul routes to North America, Frontier packs up from JFK after just two years, and a new DOT rule means your broken plane might not get you a hotel room anymore.
